SELECT
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  o.order_id,
  o.payment_order_id,
  d.delivery_id,
  d.delivery_order_id,
  d.delivery_status
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id

views.name: chunk_view_0_1
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hubs.hub_id,
  hubs.hub_name,
  orders.order_created_month,
  COUNT(orders.order_id) AS finished_orders_count
FROM hubs
JOIN stores ON stores.hub_id = hubs.hub_id
JOIN orders ON orders.store_id = stores.store_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'FINISHED'
  AND orders.order_created_year IS NOT NULL
  AND orders.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY
  hubs.hub_id,
  hubs.hub_name,
  orders.order_created_month
views.description:
Task: List the hub identifiers and their finished order counts in February and March, for hubs whose finished orders increased by more than 20% from February to March.
Required outputs: hub identifier

views.name: chunk_view_0_2
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.driver_id,
  del.delivery_id,
  del.delivery_order_id,
  del.delivery_status,
  del.delivery_distance_meters,
  o.order_moment_delivered,
  -- derive delivery_date from available timestamp in this chunk
  DATE(o.order_moment_delivered) AS delivery_date
FROM drivers d
JOIN deliveries del
  ON d.driver_id = del.driver_id
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON del.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
views.description:
Task: Find the five delivery drivers who have the highest average number of daily deliveries and return each driver's identifier along with their average daily deliveries.
Required outputs: driver ide
